meta.title: SCIM User Provisioning with SSO Configuration missing or misconfigured (DEP-005)
gaps: Access or inspect SSO Configuration settings and leave them missing or misconfigured
Observe SCIM auto-provisioning and verify that users use password login without SSO, or verify that Procol blocks the configuration
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Access or inspect SSO Configuration settings and leave them missing or misconfigured; Configure SCIM User Provisioning; Observe SCIM auto-provisioning and verify that users use password login without SSO, or verify that Procol blocks the configuration

args.need: open the admin SSO and SCIM settings, leave SSO missing or misconfigured, configure SCIM User Provisioning, and observe whether users are provisioned with password login or the configuration is safely blocked

steps.note: No catalog step can reach or operate the SSO/SCIM administration workflow or observe its provisioning consequence.
Confirm the application did not crash or show an unhandled error after the tester performed the unavailable workflow.
